summary.text: Stephanie Popescu is the Democratic candidate for Maryland State Senate District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which Republican Kevin Ford is also running.
An elementary school teacher, she won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary over Paul Henderson and Paul Konka.

paragraphs.text: Popescu earned a bachelor's degree from Loyola University Maryland and has worked as an elementary school teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign said she has spent more than a decade as a public school teacher and that early in her career she worked three jobs while teaching full-time.

The survey listed her priorities as a balanced state budget without increasing the tax burden, higher pay and support for teachers, and addressing utility costs, grocery prices and the housing shortage.
It named Delegate Michele Guyton of District 42B among her endorsers.
